import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Calculate t-statistics for each feature
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            continue  # Skip clinical features for now
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
        t, _ = stats.ttest_ind(y0, y1, equal_var=False)
        t_stats.append((abs(t), fid))
    
    # Sort by absolute t-statistic and take top 3
    t_stats.sort(reverse=True)
    top_features = [fid for _, fid in t_stats[:3]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated with |r| >= 0.6)
    selected_ids = set()
    filtered_features = []
    
    for fid in top_features:
        is_correlated = False
        for selected_fid in selected_ids:
            col_a = feats.column(selected_fid)
            col_b = feats.column(fid)
            corr = abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col_a], feats.x[:, col_b])[0, 1])
            if corr >= 0.6:
                is_correlated = True
                break
        
        if not is_correlated:
            selected_ids.add(fid)
            filtered_features.append(fid)
            
        if len(selected_ids) >= MAX_DRIVERS:
            break
    
    # Use only top 2 features for regression to keep model small
    columns = filtered_features[:2]
    
    # No interaction terms to keep model simple
    products = ()
    
    # Simple weighted score (equal weights)
    loadings = {fid: 1.0 for fid in columns}
    
    # Return first feature as driver
    drivers = (filtered_features[0],) if filtered_features else ()
    
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=products,
        loadings=loadings
    )
